newsitem.title: USA: US mortgage-backeds slip modestly, spreads narrow.
newsitem.headline: US mortgage-backeds slip modestly, spreads narrow.

text.p: U.S. mortgage-backed securities prices declined modestly on Tuesday, with spreads narrowing slightly to Treasuries, traders said.
"Spreads were unchanged to slightly tighter," said a trader at a large New York investment bank.

The Redbook weekly retail sales report added to Treasuries' losses late in the afternoon, helping to bring spreads in, he said. The report showed sales were up 1.1 percent in the first week of March versus February.
Earlier in the day, analysts cited flows out of Treasuries into asset-backeds, but traders said they had not seen a similar pattern in mortgage-backeds.
"I have not seen that in anything we do," one trader said.
In specific coupons, Ginnie Mae 30-year 7.5 percent paper was off 2/32 at 99-27/32, yielding 97 basis points over the 10-year Treasury note.
Comparable Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac paper was off 2/32 as well, at 99-27/32 and 100-01/32, respectively.
The 10-year Treasury note was off 7/32 at 97-20/32, yielding 6.58 percent.
